{{Quote|Instead of ruling a modest planet as when you met me&hellip; I'm reduced to being a ''pirate'' again!|Raskar, to Han Solo|<ref name="ANewBeginning">"[[A New Beginning]]"</ref>}}
'''Antipose''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It had a single [[Antipose city|city]] where the former [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|pirate]] [[Raskar]] set up a system of [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] contests that had a [[power gem]], a rare artifact that Raskar had in his possession, as their ultimate prize. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were tasked by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with obtaining a power [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]] for its disabling effect on [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. The pair traveled to the [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] to acquire leads, and an [[Raskar's agent|agent]] of Raskar's pointed them to Antipose.

Arriving on Antipose, Solo and Chewbacca were briefly confronted by a [[Unidentified Human 1 (Antipose)|trio]] [[Unidentified Human 2 (Antipose)|of]] [[Unidentified alien (Antipose)|contestants]] before Raskar's enforcer, [[Mystra]], took the pair to meet the ex-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] in his [[Raskar's villa|villa]]. There, Raskar demonstrated the power gem to the smugglers and attempted to persuade Solo to enter the competitions in the [[Antipose Arena|gladiatorial arena]]. Instead, Solo set into motion a different plan to acquire the power gem.

Convincing Chewbacca to start a public, impromptu fight with the arena system's [[Unidentified gladiator|top contender]], Solo used the distraction offered by the gathering crowd of onlookers to sneak into Raskar's villa and [[Portable scanner/Legends|scan]] the power gem. The smuggler determined that the artifact only had enough potency left for one proper use&mdash;a fact that Raskar had not disclosed to any of the contestants&mdash;and then persuaded Raskar to declare Chewbacca the ultimate winner of the competitions and therefore turn the gem over to him and Solo. The two smugglers then brought the power gem back to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel Alliance base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Looks like a jillion other places where we've hid out or done business.|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:AntiposeCityMystraFloater-ThePowerGem.jpg|thumb|right|400px|The terrain on Antipose]]
Antipose<ref name="UnstatedCanon">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> located in the [[Antipose system/Legends|Antipose system]], a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Falko Run]] linked it to the [[Falko system/Legends|Falko]] and [[Paulking system/Legends|Paulking systems]].<ref name="TEA Antipose" /> Antipose [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Antipose system star|sun]] that loomed large and [[Color/Legends|yellow]] in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]], and a large, dark-blue celestial body was also visible from the planet and at one point occulted the [[Star/Legends|star]].<ref name="PowerGem" />

A world with [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] as well as several landmasses, Antipose featured a hilly terrain. The planet's wildlife included [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]], and it was also [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to various [[Plant/Legends|plants]], such as [[Tree/Legends|trees]], as well as large [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] growths that were either red-colored with black mottles or yellow with black or red mottles.<ref name="PowerGem" />

==History==
===Searching for the power gems===
{{Quote|Your little drinking buddy thinks he ''saw'' one on this ''rimworld'' we're headed for&hellip;?|Han Solo, discussing power gems with Chewbacca|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:RaskarPowerGem-ThePowerGem.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Raskar set up a gladiatorial contest system on Antipose with his power gem as the ultimate prize.]]
Following the [[Skirmish over Vuchelle|destruction]] of the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_1.html|Jedi Smash Iridium Pirates; 3 Knights Killed}}, which is presented as a contemporary [[in-universe]] account of the [[Skirmish over Vuchelle|destruction]] of the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]], is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:3:28," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the member of the group [[Raskar]] retired from [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] with a [[power gem]]<ref name="PowerGem" />&mdash;a rare artifact composed of a<ref name="CSWE power">{{CSWECite|III|40|power gem}}</ref> [[Meteorite/Legends|meteoritic]]<ref name="DoomMission">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref> [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that could disable the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]<ref name="CSWE power" />&mdash;in his possession. Realizing that using the artifact in order to attack ships inevitably attracted unwanted attention to the user themselves, Raskar instead settled on Antipose,<ref name="PowerGem" /> becoming the ruler of what he thought as a "modest" planet.<ref name="ANewBeginning" /> He then organized a system of [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competitions with the power [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]] as the prize for the ultimate winner. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], many individuals sought to participate in the gladiatorial fights, with the former pirate collecting [[Antipose Arena|arena]] admissions&mdash;from both the audience and the participants&mdash;as well as percentages from all associated [[Gambling/Legends|betting]].<ref name="PowerGem" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">"[[The Power Gem]]" is set after the events of {{Film|IV}} and before the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], therefore placing it in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was tasked by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] with finding and obtaining a power gem in order to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] combat the new<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="SSDDatabank">{{DB|starship|superstardestroyer|Super Star Destroyer}}</ref> Intending to begin the search for the legendary gems in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] underworld, Solo and his [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], traveled in their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], to the<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC Junkfort">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Junkfort system]]</ref> [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]]. There, an [[Raskar's agent|alien]]&mdash;who, unbeknownst to Solo and Chewbacca, was an agent for Raskar&mdash;pointed the pair to Antipose, claiming he had seen a power gem there.<ref name="PowerGem" />

===Two smugglers on a rimworld===
{{Quote|You three were trying to eliminate ''competition''! Get off the planet&hellip; ''fast''!|Mystra, to a trio of contestants for the power gem|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:AntiposeArrival-ThePowerGem.jpg|thumb|right|400px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' arrives on Antipose.]]
Traveling to Antipose aboard the ''Falcon'', Solo and Chewbacca set the [[Light freighter/Legends|ship]] down outside the planet's [[Antipose city|only city]], with Solo noting that the world reminded him of many others they had visited during their smuggling career. Exiting the ''Falcon'', Solo [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] an attractive [[Alien/Legends|alien]] before he and Chewbacca were confronted by a [[Unidentified Human 1 (Antipose)|trio]] [[Unidentified Human 2 (Antipose)|of]] [[Unidentified alien (Antipose)|individuals]] who, being interested in acquiring the power gem themselves, attempted to intimidate any new potential contestants into leaving the planet.<ref name="PowerGem" />

Subtly preparing for a [[lightfight]], Solo and Chewbacca positioned themselves so that they would have the three contestants in a crossfire, with Solo maneuvering so that Antipose's sun would be in his opponent's eyes. At that moment, Raskar's enforcer [[Mystra]] arrived at the landing field on a [[Airspeeder/Legends|floater]], interrupting the confrontation and ordering that the trio harassing Solo and Chewbacca leave the planet. Instructing the two smugglers onto the floater, Mystra took them to Antipose's [[City/Legends|city]], where she briefly showed the pair the Antipose Arena before traveling to [[Raskar's villa]].<ref name="PowerGem" />

===Troubles for Raskar===
{{Quote|&hellip;We'll face a ''riot'' if we interfere or ''harm'' either fighter!''"<br />"''Meantime, we lose a ''fortune'' by not collecting arena admissions or gambling percentages!|Mystra and Raskar|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:ChewbaccaGladiator-EpicCollectionTheNewspaperStripsVol2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Chewbacca fighting a gladiator on Antipose]]
At his residence, Raskar was engaged in a [[fencing]] sparring session with a [[Duelist Elite/Legends|Duelist Elite]] [[Unidentified Duelist Elite|training droid]]. Intent on motivating Solo to enter the gladiatorial contest in the arena, Raskar arranged a private demonstration of the power gem during which he used the artifact to shatter a [[Force field/Legends|force field]]. The ex-pirate then explained to Solo his reason for offering to part with the gem as well as his business model on Antipose. Since<ref name="PowerGem" /> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] had placed a high [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Solo that Raskar was interested in collecting, he then offered to let the smuggler participate in the gladiatorial fights for the power gem for free. Formulating a plan to obtain a power gem that did not involve fighting in the arena at all, Solo agreed on the condition that his mighty [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion be allowed to fight on his behalf instead.<ref name="PowerGem" />

After Solo and Chewbacca left the villa, they were briefly confronted by Mystra, who unsuccessfully attempted to intimidate Solo into not trying to game the system of the gladiatorial contests. The enforcer then continued observing the two smugglers from a distance while Solo obtained directions to the training grounds of a hulking [[Unidentified gladiator|alien gladiator]] who was the leading contender for the power gem. Solo then convinced Chewbacca to instigate a brawl with the gladiator at the very same site, in violation of the planetary rule prohibiting any fighting outside of the arena. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] smuggler used the distraction provided by the massing crowd of onlookers to slip away unnoticed while Raskar and Mystra used floaters to commence a search for him, as the ex-pirate wished to punish Solo for cheating him out of his profits from the fight.<ref name="PowerGem" />

===Showdown===
{{Quote|Raskar, you've milked the gladiatorial contest for the power gem all you ''can''&hellip; time to declare a ''winner''!|Han Solo|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
Sneaking into Raskar's villa, Solo proceeded to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] his way into the chamber where the power gem was being kept. He also picked up Raskar's fencing [[Sword/Legends|sword]] and thus activated the ex-pirate's [[Training droid/Legends|training droid]], who proceeded to attack Solo. The latter maneuvered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] into the path of the destructive energy beams protecting the power gem. Meanwhile, Raskar had been alerted to Solo's break-in at the power gem chamber and the firing of the beams, and he therefore assumed that the smuggler had been killed. By the time Raskar and Mystra arrived at the villa, Solo had used a [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] to determine that the potency of the artifact's effect on shields was gradually diminishing and the gem was only still good for one proper use against a starship.<ref name="PowerGem" />

[[File:RaskarMystraSoloPowerGem-ThePowerGem.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Han Solo (right) convinced Raskar (center) to give the power gem to him after discovering the truth about the artifact's limitations.]]
Confronting Raskar about his deception, Solo persuaded the ex-pirate out of simply [[Death/Legends|killing]] him in order to prevent the contestants of the gladiatorial fights from learning about it. The smuggler convinced Raskar to declare Chewbacca the ultimate winner of the competition, since the Rebel Alliance was at that point only interested in using the power gem once anyway and therefore the two smugglers had no interest in publicly revealing Raskar's deception. After Solo subsequently informed Chewbacca that their plan had worked and that he no longer needed to prolong the fight as a distraction, the tired and irritated Wookiee proceeded to promptly defeat his opponent. Receiving the power gem from Raskar, the pair then departed Antipose aboard the ''Falcon'',<ref name="PowerGem" /> returning to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Alliance base]] on<ref name="Iceworld">"[[Iceworld]]"</ref> the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TEA" /> Raskar, on the other hand, eventually experienced financial difficulties and was forced to return to interstellar piracy.<ref name="ANewBeginning" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|The only combat tolerated ''here'' is the ''official one'' for the power gem!|Mystra|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
By 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY" /> Antipose was located relatively far from the influence sphere of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The only city on Antipose was inhabited by [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]-speaking members of various [[Species/Legends|species]], including<ref name="PowerGem" /> the planet's ruler,<ref name="ANewBeginning" /> the Human Raskar, and the alien Mystra. In order to safeguard Raskar's source of income, combat in the city and its vicinity was only allowed in the gladiatorial arena, with Mystra enforcing the rule and at one point ordering lawbreakers to depart the planet.<ref name="PowerGem" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Mystra, you've got jokers ''paying'' for the chance to get their ''heads'' busted in that arena?|Han Solo|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
Antipose was the site of a single city that consisted of stone buildings. The largest villa in the settlement was owned by the ex-pirate Raskar. He also owned<ref name="PowerGem" /> the Antipose Arena,<ref name="Gladiators" /> a large gladiatorial arena located elsewhere in the city; and a starship landing field was situated on the city's outskirts.<ref name="PowerGem" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|<nowiki />''Antipose'' is Raskar's world from the old Archie Goodwin&ndash;penned newspaper strips.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="UnstatedCanon" />}}
The planet on which Raskar hosted the gladiatorial competitions for the power gem was introduced in "[[The Power Gem]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Archie Goodwin]], penciled by [[Al Williamson]], and published between [[July 26]] and [[October 3]], [[1982]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> as part of the daily [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip]] distributed by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] to major American and Canadian newspapers from [[1979]] to [[1984]].<ref name="Insider2012">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2012|The Empire Strips Back}}</ref>

The planet remained unnamed<ref name="PowerGem" /> until [[2009]], when [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="UnstatedCanon" /> one of the co-authors of the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' released that year,<ref name="TEA" /> established in his [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog]] on [[StarWars.com]] that "Antipose,"<ref name="UnstatedCanon" /> a location name included in the book<ref name="TEA" /> and shared with the celestial bodies [[Antipose IX]]<ref name="LCMS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> and [[Antipose XII]] that had been introduced in other ''[[Star Wars]]'' sources,<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> referred to the planet from "The Power Gem."<ref name="UnstatedCanon" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Antipose [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet Antipose, in grid square U-8.<ref name="TEA" />
